+func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+
+	serial, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), 128))
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+
+	cert := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          serial,
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "redis"},
+		DNSNames:              []string{"redis"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Minute),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature | x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		ExtKeyUsage:           []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+	certDER, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+	keyDER, err := x509.MarshalECPrivateKey(key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+	certPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: certDER}))
+	keyPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "EC PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: keyDER}))
+
+	redis := client.Container().
+		From("redis:alpine").
+		WithNewFile("/certs/server.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
+		WithNewFile("/certs/server.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: keyPEM}).
+		WithExposedPort(6379).
+		WithExec([]string{"redis-server", "--port", "0", "--tls-port", "6379", "--tls-cert-file", "/certs/server.crt", "--tls-key-file", "/certs/server.key", "--tls-ca-cert-file", "/certs/server.crt", "--tls-auth-clients", "no"})
+
+	flipt = flipt.
+		WithServiceBinding("redis", redis.AsService()).
+		WithNewFile("/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_PATH", "/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem")
+
+	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f0226be
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client.go
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, errors.New("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{
+			MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
+			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS, //nolint:gosec // Explicitly configured by the user.
+		}
+
+		var cert []byte
+		if cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			cert = []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+		} else if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+			var err error
+			cert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+
+		if cert != nil {
+			roots := x509.NewCertPool()
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(cert) {
+				return nil, errors.New("invalid redis CA certificate")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	server := httptest.NewTLSServer(nil)
+	defer server.Close()
+	cert := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: server.Certificate().Raw}))
+	certPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(certPath, []byte(cert), 0600))
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name         string
+		config       config.RedisCacheConfig
+		wantRoots    bool
+		wantTLS      bool
+		wantInsecure bool
+	}{
+		{name: "plain connection"},
+		{name: "system trust", config: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true}, wantTLS: true},
+		{name: "inline CA", config: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: cert}, wantTLS: true, wantRoots: true},
+		{name: "CA path", config: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: certPath}, wantTLS: true, wantRoots: true},
+		{name: "insecure TLS", config: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, InsecureSkipTLS: true}, wantTLS: true, wantInsecure: true},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tt.config)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+
+			tlsConfig := client.Options().TLSConfig
+			if !tt.wantTLS {
+				require.Nil(t, tlsConfig)
+				return
+			}
+
+			require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig)
+			require.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), tlsConfig.MinVersion)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.wantInsecure, tlsConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+			if !tt.wantRoots {
+				require.Nil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+				return
+			}
+
+			require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+			_, err = server.Certificate().Verify(x509.VerifyOptions{Roots: tlsConfig.RootCAs, DNSName: "example.com"})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewClientTLSInvalidCA(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		config config.RedisCacheConfig
+		want   string
+	}{
+		{name: "both sources", config: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "data", CaCertPath: "path"}, want: "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path"},
+		{name: "missing file", config: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing.pem")}, want: "reading redis CA certificate"},
+		{name: "bad PEM", config: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "not a PEM certificate"}, want: "invalid redis CA certificate"},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tt.config)
+			require.Nil(t, client)
+			require.ErrorContains(t, err, tt.want)
+		})
+	}
+}
